reviewer: jitendex subagent, independent of VNDB and JMdict implementations
method: Read retained scripts, raw observations, summaries, parity receipts, source snapshots, failure receipts, and PR 901 wording; recompute hashes, medians, paired differences, and row/copy arithmetic. Read JMdict ZIP central metadata to verify exact planner groups. No performance, encoder, media-validation, or WASM reruns.
result: No material numerical or source-identity mismatch found. Scope qualifications below are required when presenting the results.

studyDesignPerCandidate.qualification: Each of six candidate samples is compared with both A and C in its block. Twelve comparisons do not mean twelve independent candidate samples.

combinedRetainedMemory.metric: Forced-GC retained heapUsed plus external bytes; arrayBuffers is already included in external and is not added again.

historicalLazyRetainedMemory.qualification: A distinct prior source candidate. Its lower retained-memory result must not be attributed to the final combined source.

timing.conclusion: Inconclusive; do not claim catalog or complete-import latency improvement.

correctnessScope.validationPathAudited: The executed runner compares complete catalog metadata and raw names, invokes production source-media preparation, compares record/source-span/index digests, and reaches CRC and decoded-length validation for every image.
correctnessScope.approvedDescription: Complete catalog/raw-name digests plus complete source span/index digests and every-image CRC validation.
notEstablished: Complete VNDB term encoder output parity

jmdict.portableWrapperReviewed: Python syntax parses; strict runner/source hash checks and exact-count replacements change only root constants and cache location. Wrapper was not executed.
jmdict.readmeScopeReviewed: Accurately distinguishes complete scoped encoder parity, two-worker activation, zero three/five-worker activation, and unsuccessful VNDB attempts.
jmdict.executedRunnerProvenance: Confirmed by the owning JMdict agent; original source preserved separately from the later file-backed attempt.
verified: Replayed grouping algorithm matches the checked production planner; every group boundary independently matches ZIP central metadata.
Each configuration covers all 53 banks and sums to the locked 528299 rows; segment and split-row sums agree.
The two-worker reduction equals 348299 affected rows multiplied by six bytes per row; all group and total copy deltas agree.
The executed script asserts deep equality of every baseline/candidate output envelope before adding it to the completed report.
jmdict.scope: Production record encoding and checksummed envelopes for sequentially replayed planner groups with deterministic source-content references. Not a concurrent-worker benchmark, persisted database comparison, complete content-deduplication/compression import, or timing/peak-memory result.
jmdict.qualification: Do not generalize the two-worker copy saving to three- or five-worker policies; those complete receipts show zero avoided copies.

incompleteVndbEncoderAttempts.qualification: No VNDB encoder count, byte-parity, timing, or memory result can be inferred. Keep exit 137 separate from the unknown-exit file-backed attempt; do not label either as a successful replay or infer an unobserved failure cause.

reviewLimitations: Large fixture contents were not rehashed or decompressed in this audit; their recorded verification and locked identities were reviewed, and JMdict central metadata was independently read.
Retained byte/envelope data was not regenerated. Claims are supported by inspected executed assertions, recorded complete receipts, and recomputed arithmetic.
The portable scripts are post-run path-parameterized reproductions, not additional observed runs.
Historical lazy-view validation and source identities remain distinct from the final combined candidate.
